entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for order number 944-2187B-05. It's a helmet.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the Trail Helmet purchased about 57 days ago. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?
It's the wrong color. That's it. The box is still unopened. I just want to return it.
I understand. Getting the right gear is definitely important for both comfort and safety. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. Please hold.
Just tell me yes or no.

Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, since the item was delivered within the last 90 days, you are eligible for a full refund. I've just initiated that return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Do you see it?
Got it. So I just print this and drop it off?

That's correct. Just attach the label to the shipping box and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
